notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key for the person table.
Data release cycle indicator; stored as an observation with observation_concept_id representing 'Data release number'.
Interview/examination status; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Interviewed Only, 2=Both Interviewed and MEC examined.
Six-month exam period; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Nov-Apr, 2=May-Oct.
Gender of sample person. Map 1 to 8507 (Male), 2 to 8532 (Female).
Age in years at screening; used to derive year_of_birth (survey_year - age). Topcoded at 80.
Age in months at screening for those <80 years; stored as observation for precise age.
Age in months at exam for those <80 years; stored as observation for precise age.
Race/Ethnicity recode. Hispanic groups (1,2) map to ethnicity_concept_id (Hispanic/Latino). Non-Hispanic groups (3,4,5) map to race_concept_id with ethnicity as Not Hispanic.
Served in US Armed Forces; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Country of birth recode; maps to observation. Codes: 1=US, 2=Mexico, 4=Other Spanish, 5=Other Non-Spanish.
Citizenship status; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Citizen, 2=Not citizen.
Length of time in US; maps to observation. Ordinal categories for years in US.
Education level for children/youth 6-19; maps to observation.
Education level for adults 20+; maps to observation.
Current school attendance status; maps to observation.
Marital status; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Married, 2=Widowed, 3=Divorced, 4=Separated, 5=Never married.
Total number of people in household; maps to observation as numeric value.
Total number of people in family; maps to observation as numeric value.
Annual household income range; maps to observation.
Annual family income range; maps to observation.
Ratio of family income to poverty threshold; maps to observation as continuous numeric value.
Pregnancy status at exam for females 20-44; maps to observation.
Household reference person gender; not mapped to participant's person record. Could be stored in observation if needed.
Household reference person age; not mapped to participant's person record.
Household reference person country of birth; not mapped to participant's person record.
Household reference person education; not mapped to participant's person record.
Household reference person marital status; not mapped to participant's person record.
Spouse of household reference person education; not mapped to participant's person record.
Language of SP interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=English, 2=Spanish.
Proxy used in SP interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Interpreter used in SP interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Language of family interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=English, 2=Spanish.
Proxy used in family interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Interpreter used in family interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Language of MEC interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=English, 2=Spanish.
Proxy used in MEC interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Interpreter used in MEC interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=Yes, 2=No.
Language of ACASI interview; maps to observation. Codes: 1=English, 2=Spanish.
Full sample 2-year interview weight; stored as observation for survey design weight.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight; stored as observation for survey design weight.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU; stored as observation for survey design variable.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum; stored as observation for survey design variable.
